"""Exhaustive fixed-grid evaluation of the admitted Kalshi historical extension."""
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.json as paj
from scipy.stats import t

from analyze_transfer import stat
from dskit.pipeline.fee_mechanics import ProbabilityQuadraticFee, CeilToTick

OUT = Path(__file__).parent
FEE = ProbabilityQuadraticFee(CeilToTick(.01))
STRINGS = ["ticker","asset","day","band"]
INTS = ["decision_ms","settlement_ms","lead_minutes"]
FLOATS = ["label","mid","prediction","cal_market","model_logloss","market_logloss",
          "cal_logloss","model_brier","market_brier","cal_brier","yes_bid","yes_ask",
          "candle_age_ms","spot_age_ms"]
SCHEMA = pa.schema([(x,pa.string()) for x in STRINGS]+
                   [(x,pa.int64()) for x in INTS]+
                   [(x,pa.float64()) for x in FLOATS]+
                   [(x,pa.bool_()) for x in ["two_sided","quote_missing"]])


def summary(values, days, family):
    """Reuse the earlier cluster calculation and retain both sources of uncertainty."""
    result = stat(values,days,family)
    if not len(values):
        result.update(wins=0,losses=0)
    return result


def tails(r, y, entry, fee, family):
    """Add the frozen rare-loss diagnostics without promoting all-win t-statistics."""
    n = len(y)
    wins = int(np.sum(y))
    r.update(wins=wins,losses=n-wins,tail_warning=(wins<5 or n-wins<5))
    r["allwin_independence_lower_net"] = (float(np.exp(np.log(.05/family)/n)-np.mean(entry+fee))
                                         if n and wins==n else None)
    r["one_extra_loss_net"] = float(r["mean"]-1/n) if n else None
    r["five_extra_losses_net"] = float(r["mean"]-5/n) if n else None


def main():
    """Evaluate every frozen model/cell and both decision-selected purchased sides."""
    protocol = json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text())
    family = protocol["uncertainty"]["family"]
    windows = [x for x in protocol["windows"] if x["venue"]=="Kalshi"]
    manifests = json.loads((OUT/"run-manifest.json").read_text())
    prediction = []
    costs = []
    audit = []
    reference = None
    for item in manifests:
        if item["status"]!="completed":
            continue
        path = Path(item["predictions"])
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item["predictions_sha256"]
        data = paj.read_json(path,parse_options=paj.ParseOptions(explicit_schema=SCHEMA,unexpected_field_behavior="ignore")).to_pandas()
        assert len(data)==item["rows"]
        assert not data.duplicated(["ticker","lead_minutes"]).any()
        assert (data.decision_ms<data.settlement_ms).all()
        assert (data.settlement_ms<1791763200000).all()
        data = data.sort_values(["ticker","lead_minutes"]).reset_index(drop=True)
        identity = data[["ticker","lead_minutes","mid","cal_market","label","decision_ms","settlement_ms"]]
        if reference is None:
            reference = identity.copy()
        else:
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(reference,identity,check_exact=True)
        data["bin"] = np.minimum(9,(data.mid*10).astype(int))
        data["day_index"] = data.settlement_ms//86400000
        policy = item["namespace"]+f'{item["method"]:02d}'
        policies = [policy,"raw","cal"] if len(audit)==0 else [policy]
        for window in windows:
            start = int(pd.Timestamp(window["start"],tz="UTC").timestamp()*1000)
            end = int(pd.Timestamp(window["end_before"],tz="UTC").timestamp()*1000)
            split = int(pd.Timestamp(window["stability_split"],tz="UTC").timestamp()*1000)
            d = data[(data.settlement_ms>=start)&(data.settlement_ms<end)].copy()
            for asset,lead,b in itertools.product(["BTC","ETH"],protocol["leads"],range(10)):
                cell = d[(d.asset==asset)&(d.lead_minutes==lead)&(d.bin==b)]
                r = dict(window=window["id"],model=policy,asset=asset,lead=lead,bin=b,
                         n=len(cell),contracts=cell.ticker.nunique(),days=cell.day.nunique(),
                         exposure=window["exposure"])
                for name in ["mid","prediction","cal_market","label","model_logloss","market_logloss","cal_logloss","model_brier","market_brier","cal_brier"]:
                    r[name] = float(cell[name].mean()) if len(cell) else None
                for comp in ["market","cal"]:
                    for loss in ["logloss","brier"]:
                        delta = cell[comp+"_"+loss]-cell["model_"+loss]
                        r.update({comp+"_"+loss+"_gain_"+k:v for k,v in summary(delta,cell.day_index,family).items()})
                        for half,mask in [("early",cell.settlement_ms<split),("late",cell.settlement_ms>=split)]:
                            r[comp+"_"+loss+"_"+half+"_gain"] = float(delta[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else None
                prediction.append(r)
            for code,side,size in itertools.product(policies,["YES","NO"],protocol["scenarios"]["shares"]):
                base = d.mid.to_numpy() if code=="raw" else d.cal_market.to_numpy() if code=="cal" else d.prediction.to_numpy()
                probability = base if side=="YES" else 1-base
                y = d.label.to_numpy() if side=="YES" else 1-d.label.to_numpy()
                price = d.yes_ask.to_numpy() if side=="YES" else 1-d.yes_bid.to_numpy()
                fees = np.array([FEE.order_fee(size,float(x),.07)/size if np.isfinite(x) and 0<=x<=1 else np.nan for x in price])
                eligible = (d.two_sided.eq(True)&d.quote_missing.eq(False)&d.candle_age_ms.eq(0)&
                            d.yes_bid.between(0,1)&d.yes_ask.between(0,1)&(d.yes_bid<=d.yes_ask)).to_numpy()
                signal = eligible & (probability>price+fees)
                net = y-price-fees
                for asset,lead,b in itertools.product(["BTC","ETH"],protocol["leads"],range(10)):
                    cell = (d.asset.to_numpy()==asset)&(d.lead_minutes.to_numpy()==lead)&(d.bin.to_numpy()==b)
                    mask = cell&signal
                    g = d[mask]
                    a = net[mask]
                    r = dict(window=window["id"],model=code,asset=asset,lead=lead,bin=b,side=side,shares=size,
                             cell_n=int(cell.sum()),eligible_n=int((cell&eligible).sum()),
                             contracts=g.ticker.nunique(),exposure=window["exposure"],
                             cost_status="candle_cost_scenario_no_delayed_fill_or_depth_claim")
                    r.update(summary(a,g.day_index,family))
                    for name,value in [("predicted_probability",probability),("entry_price",price),
                                       ("fee",fees),("realized",y),("predicted_cost_buffer",probability-price-fees)]:
                        r[name] = float(value[mask].mean()) if len(g) else None
                    r["minus_half_cent"] = float(a.mean()-.005) if len(g) else None
                    r["minus_one_cent"] = float(a.mean()-.01) if len(g) else None
                    for half,hmask in [("early",g.settlement_ms<split),("late",g.settlement_ms>=split)]:
                        r[half+"_n"] = int(hmask.sum())
                        r[half+"_mean"] = float(a[hmask.to_numpy()].mean()) if hmask.any() else None
                    tails(r,y[mask],price[mask],fees[mask],family)
                    r["adequate"] = len(g)>=200 and r["day_clusters"]>=20 and r["week_clusters"]>=4
                    r["inference_supported"] = bool(r["adequate"] and not r["tail_warning"] and r["day_adjusted_p"]<.05 and r["week_adjusted_p"]<.05)
                    costs.append(r)
        audit.append(dict(policy=policy,rows=len(data),contracts=data.ticker.nunique(),sha256=item["predictions_sha256"]))
        print("aggregated",policy,"score_rows",len(prediction),"cost_rows",len(costs),flush=True)
    pd.DataFrame(prediction).to_csv(OUT/"kalshi-prediction-cells.csv",index=False)
    frame = pd.DataFrame(costs)
    frame.to_csv(OUT/"kalshi-cost-scenarios.csv",index=False)
    frame[frame.shares==10].to_csv(OUT/"kalshi-cost-primary.csv",index=False)
    (OUT/"kalshi-aggregation.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(inputs=audit,score_rows=len(prediction),cost_rows=len(costs),family=family),indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
